dataset_audit.verdict: No untouched independent annotated pothole detection test dataset exists in the repository. dataset_unified/test (153 imgs) and external_rangoon (35 imgs) were previously inspected and exhibit cross-split perceptual near-duplicates or incomplete clip annotations; evaluation/ground_truth_labels/ has 0 annotated boxes. Detection metrics are therefore strictly reported as EXPLORATORY.

detection.independent_generalization_reason: No untouched independent annotated pothole detection dataset exists (evaluation/ground_truth_labels/ has 0 annotations and dataset_unified contains 328 suspected cross-split near-duplicate pairs dHash<=6). All dataset_unified and external_rangoon metrics are EXPLORATORY ONLY.

geometry.synthetic_disclaimer: Synthetic reference-plane RMSE and timings reflect analytic surface recovery and CPU latency ONLY; they do NOT establish physical metric pothole depth accuracy.

segmentation_grouped_test_evaluation.domain_shift_note: Pothole440 contains close-up overhead pothole images domain-shifted from dashcam road scenes (N=15 unaugmented originals). Improved mask IoU does NOT prove physical depth accuracy.

depth_cavity.scientific_caveat: DAv2 518 serves strictly as a higher-resolution relative consistency reference, NOT physical metric ground truth. MiDaS and DAv2 raw residual magnitudes are not directly comparable.
